title: Walsingham letter-book, 24 Jan 1572/3: Burghley to Walsingham, clear letter with two boxed cover-name markers, BL Harley MS 260 f. 395 (DECODE R8362)

documents.shelfmark: BL Harley MS 260 f. 395r; DECODE R8362

plaintext.source: The letter is clear; printed in Digges, The Compleat Ambassador (1655).

transcription.notes: Two boxed 9s, after the cover-names Lyons and Roome.

system.summary: No substitution text: two boxed-digit markers after cover-names (place names for persons) in a clear letter.
system.notes: Copy in a letter-book; the codes were copied from the sent letters.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Downloaded the R8362 image with the DECODE cookie (decrypt-custom filesrv, _P.jpg).
Read the page: clear Burghley letter, 24 Jan 1572/3; only boxed 9 after Lyons and Roome.
Found the letter in Digges 1655 (digges1655.txt l. 24938).
Boxed digit after a word = cover-name marker (R8361 digges_codes inventory); nothing to decipher.

outcome.method_basis: R8362 is a clear copy of Burghley's letter to Walsingham of 24 Jan 1572/3 in Walsingham's letter-book (Harley 260 f. 395), printed by Digges 1655; its only marks are two boxed 9s that flag cover-names.
outcome.notes: Clear letter; the two cipher marks are cover-name markers. Identity behind Lyons/Roome not established.
